label: PD-T4-4 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a PD-T4-4 locus represented by DefenseFinder as a two-profile model requiring PD-T4-4__PD-T4-4_A and PD-T4-4__PD-T4-4_B, and experimentally linked to T2, T4, T6, and SECphi17 protection when expressed in E. coli.
observations: PD-T4-4 branch under phage defense system; distinct from the individual PD-T4-4_A or PD-T4-4_B genes or proteins, the DefenseFinder PD-T4-4__PD-T4-4_A and PD-T4-4__PD-T4-4_B profiles, the PD-T4-4 source key, phage protection outside a complete PD-T4-4 locus, RefSeq example loci without experimental validation, sibling PD-T4 systems, integrative and conjugative elements as mobile elements, and other phage-defense systems.
